data.text:
Luke, I appreciate your offer to sit April out, but you deserve a share too. My family has fished here for generations, and I want the lake to keep supporting all of us. Why take 60 tons now and squeeze everyone next month when we can catch 50 each month and let the lake recover to 100?

I’ll commit to 10 tons this month and propose the same for everyone: $10,000 each, with a full lake again in May. We can review our catches together afterward and agree on any adjustments. John, will you commit to 10 rather than 15?
